name: US–China / Taiwan
value: No blockade or clash; Shenzhen talks 19 Nov
summary: Trump met Xi, then Putin and Xi together, in Shenzhen on 19 Nov; no blockade, clash or severed channel found
state: Trump held separate talks with Putin and Xi in Shenzhen on 19 Nov before a three-way meeting (CNBC); the talks ended with no immediate joint statement (NBC News). They followed US restrictions announced on 16 Nov limiting Chinese firms' use of advanced chips through data centres abroad. No blockade, military clash or severed diplomatic channel was found as of 19 Nov; Watch holds on new export controls.
